nary_nodes.label: Engagement announced
evidence: The couple announced their engagement on social media on Tuesday with photos of the proposal, showing Herbert down on one knee holding a ring box as Beer crouched down in front of him, beaming.
The joint post was captioned: "meet my fiancé".
